name: Alexander Crummell
summary: Alexander Crummell (March 3, 1819 – September 10, 1898) was a minister, author, abolitionist, and academic. Born to free black parents in New York City, Crummell attended various educational institutions and was ordained as an Episcopal priest in the United States. He was a member of Prince Hall Freemasonry.
